goals: Verify the TestModelMapper's ability to insert a TestModel object into the database.
Verify the pagination functionality of TestModelService correctly returns paged results with the expected page size and number of elements.
activities: Set the age of the TestModel to 1.
Set the creation timestamp of the TestModel to the current date.
Set the update timestamp of the TestModel to the current date.
Set the username of the TestModel to "lalal".
Insert the TestModel object into the database using the mapper.
Insert 100 TestModel objects into the database in a loop.
Retrieve a paginated list of TestModel objects from the service, with ID greater than 0, for page 1 with 20 items per page.
Assert that the page size of the retrieved paginated list is greater than or equal to 5.
Assert that the number of elements in the retrieved page is equal to 20.
